transport.identity: Each observer directory is its actual positive PID; every row's PID and integer sequence must match. Request IDs are unique positive admission ordinals within that PID.
transport.lifecycle: Each admitted request has exactly one raw body-complete, one finish, one close; both body-complete and finish precede close. Their relative order may be either.
transport.returned_methods: Every raw accepted_argument is verified; method ordinals are unique and gap-free. Return records need not precede finish because synchronous nested callbacks may interleave.
refusal: missing raw body end or finish/close
body-end after close remains explicit OPEN; no demonstrated frozen positive exception
transport.assertions: Original fixture bytes/assertions are not modified. After the actual original PASS check, state.source_assertions_passed=True is separate from evaluator transport qualification. A lifecycle refusal writes fixture-verdict qualified:false/transport_complete:false/OPEN before STOP.
transport.expected_abort: No expected-abort exception is authorized. Any future exception needs exact frozen case evidence and separate review; never silently qualify truncated transport.

budgets.process_formula: min(original requested per-stage seconds, Root remaining - 25 - 5 - Root controller evidence reserve); nonpositive -> STOP before OS process start.
budgets.helper_absolute_deadline: Root inner deadline - controller evidence reserve. Helper independently caps effective timeout to absolute remaining minus25 minus5; cleanup and finalization deadlines are min(local phase deadline, Root absolute deadline).
budgets.helper_tail: Generation proof loop checks finalization deadline. Owned handles still receive cleanup even at/after deadline; final helper tail sets timed_out and complete:false on lateness, preserving first failure. Deadline checks cannot preempt blocking Windows API; external Root-owned process boundary remains required.
budgets.outer_formula: outer_seconds > inner_seconds +25 +5 +Root launcher evidence reserve, including preparation elapsed check. Actual inner-child timeout = remaining outer -5 -launcher evidence reserve, and must exceed inner+25 before start.
budgets.evidence: Request records requested/effective/remaining,25/5/IO reservations and absolute deadline; helper records its own effective timeout and deadlines. Controller and launcher evidence IO tails refuse success past their budgets.
budgets.limits: No Root numerical total or resource allocation is invented. New two IO reserve fields remain NULL in scope. All actual process/runtime timings are NOT_RUN.
